scope: execution time of the reference SQL (cr_side) on SQLite and the reference Cypher on Neo4j, one query per item, read-only

design.order: items in file order; SQLite first, then Neo4j
design.connections: one SQLite connection and one Neo4j session per working group, sequential
design.timedRegion: time.perf_counter around execute and fetch-all; gold comparison outside
design.neo4jTimedCall: list(session.run(cypher, anchor=graph_key(anchor))) in a READ_ACCESS session
design.percentile: linear interpolation between order statistics, position (n - 1) * q

goldComparison.sqlite: set of returned rows == set of gold rows
goldComparison.neo4j: sorted list of returned rows == sorted list of gold rows

host.pinning: taskset -c 12-15 on the measuring Python process (driver and in-process SQLite); the Neo4j server processes run in containers and are not pinned by it

pack_lookup.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE m.cr = :anchor
pack_lookup.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting

disposition_pack.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM disposition d JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
disposition_pack.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting

operators.details: d.dispositionCode AS `d.dispositionCode`, m.meetingNumber AS `m.meetingNumber`, cache[p.crPackId] AS `p.crPackId`, cache[p.tsgMeeting] AS `p.tsgMeeting`

full_chain.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting, s.clause FROM disposition d JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = d.target JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND s.clause IS NOT NULL
full_chain.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN DISTINCT d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting, s.sectionNumber

operators.details: s.sectionNumber AS `s.sectionNumber`, m.meetingNumber AS `m.meetingNumber`, d.dispositionCode AS `d.dispositionCode`, cache[p.tsgMeeting] AS `p.tsgMeeting`, cache[p.crPackId] AS `p.crPackId`

revision_chain.sql: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

sqliteExplainQueryPlan.detail: SEARCH r USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_resolution_1 (id=?)
SEARCH later USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (id=?)

revision_chain.cypher: MATCH (:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor})<-[:IS_REVISION_OF*1..]-(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, p.crPackId

operators.details: cr.tdocNumber AS `cr.tdocNumber`, d.dispositionCode AS `d.dispositionCode`, p.crPackId AS `p.crPackId`

clause_history.sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number FROM cr_modifies_section c JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
clause_history.cypher: MATCH (:Section {sectionId: $anchor})<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(cr) MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release) WHERE $anchor CONTAINS ('-' + release.releaseName + '-') MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber, p.crPackId

operators.details: cr.tdocNumber AS `cr.tdocNumber`, d.dispositionCode AS `d.dispositionCode`, m.meetingNumber AS `m.meetingNumber`, p.crPackId AS `p.crPackId`

pack_origin.sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label FROM pack_member m JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
pack_origin.cypher: MATCH (:CRPack {crPackId: $anchor})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr) MATCH (cr)<-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]-(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'}) -[:DISPOSITION_OF]->(:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"' RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber, d.dispositionCode, m.meetingNumber

operators.details: cr.tdocNumber AS `cr.tdocNumber`, d.dispositionCode AS `d.dispositionCode`, m.meetingNumber AS `m.meetingNumber`

pack_lookup_empty.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE m.cr = :anchor
pack_lookup_empty.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber: $anchor}) MATCH (cr)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting
